column7: UpdateRole persisted the role it was handed with a full-row Save: a custom role hard-deleted by a concurrent DeleteRole after core UpdateRole had read it was re-inserted under the same id (Save's UPDATE matched nothing and GORM fell back to INSERT) with the stale name and description, breaking DeleteRole's no-id-reuse premise. UpdateRole now writes description and assignable_scope only, WHERE id, and returns storage.ErrRoleNotFound on zero rows so the caller's transaction rolls back. The test asserts the roles table on SQLite (in-transaction delete) and, with KEYORIX_TEST_PG_DSN, on Postgres (a second connection commits the delete). Siblings: TestUpdateRole_ThenDelete_RoleStaysDeleted, TestUpdateRole_ConcurrentDelete_NeverResurrects, TestUpdateRole_IsColumnScoped; the full-row guard (TestFullRowWriteGuard_NoStaleFullRowWriteOnSecurityStateModels) now fails on any Save there, its RESIDUAL ledger row is deleted. Red on unmodified main fdfe4c8a (STORE-STALE-WRITE-1).
